name: 农机具作业效率（亩/小时）对比

map.输入作业幅宽、速度、时长与实际作业面积，对比理论与实际作业效率，评估机具利用率: Enter work width, speed, duration, and actual area to compare theoretical and actual efficiency and assess utilization
map.理论面积(亩) = 幅宽(m) × 速度(km/h) × 时长(h) × 1.5: Theoretical area (mu) = width (m) x speed (km/h) x duration (h) x 1.5; efficiency ratio = actual / theoretical x 100%; lost area = theoretical - actual
map.与农机效率对比同源经验系数（1.5 亩/(m·km/h·h)）。理论效率 = 理: Same empirical coefficient as the machinery efficiency comparator (1.5 mu per m.km/h.h). Theoretical efficiency = theoretical area / duration, actual = actual area / duration, ratio is their quotient. Ratio >=85% excellent, >=70% good, >=55% fair, else low, used to assess utilization and field transfer / headland turning losses.
map.💡 理论面积 = 幅宽 × 速度 × 时长 × 1.5（1 km·m·h = 1: 💡 Theoretical area = width x speed x duration x 1.5 (1 km.m.h = 1000 m2 = 1.5 mu); theoretical efficiency = theoretical area / duration; actual efficiency = actual area / duration; efficiency ratio = actual / theoretical x 100%
map.转亩系数 1.5 来源：1km/h × 1m 幅宽 × 1h = 1000㎡，1: The 1.5 mu factor: 1 km/h x 1 m width x 1 h = 1000 m2, 1 mu = 666.67 m2, 1000 / 666.67 = 1.5
map.效率比反映机具田间实际利用率，受地头转弯、加种加肥、转移等影响，一般 70%–8: Efficiency ratio reflects field utilization, affected by headland turns, refilling, and transfer; typically 70%-85%
map.作业幅宽取机具有效工作幅宽，非结构幅宽: Use the effective working width, not the structural width
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不上传，结果仅供农机作业管理参考: Pure front-end, no upload; results are for machinery operation management only
map.效率 = 作业面积 / 纯作业小时（亩/h）。: Efficiency = work area / pure work hours (mu/h).
map.多机型/多工序横向对比选优。: Cross-compare models and operations to pick the best.
map.用于合作社调度与外包议价。: Used for cooperative scheduling and outsourcing negotiation.
map.旋耕机 6 h 完成 360 亩 = 60 亩/h，深松机 6 h 完成 180: Rotary tiller 6 h does 360 mu = 60 mu/h, deep loosener 6 h does 180 mu = 30 mu/h. Rotary is fast but shallow, deep loosening slow but breaks the plow pan. Choose by tillage-layer goal not speed; often combine.
map.为什么深松慢很多？: Why is deep loosening much slower?
map.深松阻力大、需降速保质量，且深度要求严。它不是替代旋耕而是补充，解决土壤板结，频: Deep loosening has high resistance and needs slower speed for quality and strict depth. It supplements not replaces rotary tillage, fixing compaction, at lower frequency.
map.亩/h 会和标称不符？: Can mu/h differ from the rated value?
map.厂家标称多在理想条件。实际受地势、作物、机手水平影响打折扣，应以自家实测均值做计: Factory ratings are mostly ideal conditions. Actual is discounted by terrain, crop, and operator skill; use your own measured average for planning.
map.农机具作业效率对比工具，通过作业幅宽、速度、时长与实际作业面积，计算理论作业面积: This tool uses width, speed, duration, and actual area to compute theoretical area, theoretical and actual efficiency, and the ratio, assessing field utilization for machine selection and operation scheduling.
map.理论面积与实际面积对比，直观反映损失工作量: Theoretical vs actual area directly shows lost workload
map.计算理论效率、实际效率与效率比（利用率）: Computes theoretical, actual efficiency, and ratio (utilization)
map.纯前端处理，数据不上传，农机管理即开即用: Pure front-end, no upload; ready for machinery management
map.农机选型与配套动力决策: Machine selection and matching power decision
